title: Do not build green while cash-poor
description: Do not build green while cash-poor. Green requires too much capital when opponents have orange threats. The decision depends on house supply, immediate rent threat, and whether the reserve survives the build.

final_action.public_message: Building a house on Pacific Avenue.
final_action.private_thought: I have $210 cash and own the green set with 1 house each. Building a second house on Pacific Avenue costs $200, leaving $10. This boosts rent significantly and uses available houses. Mortgage not needed now.

breakdown.message: Did not satisfy: Chooses end_turn for this build/mortgage decision.
